description: Release a new version (v3.0) of a mobile app (iOS + Android) to production via staged store rollout. The app has 500K active users. The release must follow: beta ring (TestFlight / internal testing track, 100 users), staged device rollout (Google Play staged rollout: 5% → 10% → 50% → 100%; Apple App Store phased release over 7 days), per-version compatibility verification (the app must work with the current server API version — if the app requires a new API version, the server API must be deployed first and backward-compatible), and a monitoring period at each stage (crash rate, ANR rate, API error rate). A rollback plan must exist (pull the release from the store, re-promote the previous version). Risk factors: server API incompatibility (v3.0 app calls endpoints that don't exist on the current server), crash regressions on specific OS versions, and the App Store review process delay. Tools available: Google Play Console, App Store Connect, TestFlight, Firebase Crashlytics, server feature flags.
